title: Lower bound of the pulled-back complex colimit
statement: For a diagram of complexes F_i of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on a scheme diagram D [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a cone c, and an inverse-image diagram G with isomorphisms eG as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], suppose every term F_i^n vanishes for n<a. If L is a colimit cocone on G, then L.pt^n is zero for every n<a.

proof.text:
Exactness of inverse image makes every pulled back term zero below a. The
isomorphisms eG therefore make every G term zero in these degrees. Evaluation of
complexes preserves colimits, so L.pt.X n is a colimit of zero objects when n < a.
A cocone with vertex zero is then colimiting, hence this term is itself zero.
This argument works also when the index category is empty.

mathlib_searches.query: A lower bounded complex has uniform stable hypercohomology spectral sequence pages natural for pullback
mathlib_searches.results: DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE; CochainComplex.cm5b; CochainComplex.isZero_of_isLE. These are support and resolution lemmas, not the functorial page package.

Mathlib SpectralSequence.Basic has page functors and hom_ext but no coordinate-swap functor. IsColimit.isZero_pt and isColimitOfPreserves prove the colimit bound. Existing pullback presentations have object-dependent thresholds without a uniform estimate.

lean.statement: theorem etaleComplex_colimit_below {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (F : ∀ i : I, CochainComplex (Sheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ) (a : ℤ) (hbelow : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), n < a → IsZero ((F i).X n)) (G : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ) (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj (op i) ≅ ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (F i)) (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero (L.pt.X n)
